correctness.rationale: An exact calculation checks all 13 normalized combinations. For each, the binary quartic discriminant is squarefree and independent Groebner Jacobian checks give the unit ideal on all four affine charts; no extension-field truncation. The three coefficient vectors are linearly independent. The upper bound is the three-dimensional first-jet target at any rational point; the no-rational-basepoint corollary follows by the same rank argument. Smooth (2,2) divisors are connected genus-one curves by Kunneth and adjunction.
